runtime_qualification: Record UTC, monotonic wall and process CPU time per call plus Python/platform and Windows execution-state request. Preserve unexplained elapsed gaps and contention as qualifications; execution-state request is not proof of exclusive CPU or absence of suspend.

specification.allocation_boundary: Separate calls with the same solve/serialization/hash boundary; gc before tracing; Python tracemalloc peak only, not RSS.
specification.interpretation: Both entries use the same 126-world representation, recurrence and output normalization. Iterations differ 140 vs 560 and admission/baseline-authentication bookkeeping differs. Compare observed complete-call costs under different quality/work budgets; no same-work speedup, general speed, convergence or RSS claim.
specification.payload_consistency: All reports must match their independently replayed pinned pilot after removing only runtime and artifact checksum fields; all four reports per method must match one another exactly within this runtime.
specification.retention: Persist active request before each call and index after each result/error. Save all eight complete raw reports losslessly when produced, including misses. Never discard outliers, retry a timed sample or relabel failures.
specification.runtime_qualification: Record UTC, monotonic wall and process CPU time per call plus Python/platform and Windows execution-state request. Preserve unexplained elapsed gaps and contention as qualifications; execution-state request is not proof of exclusive CPU or absence of suspend.
specification.source_policy: Committed clean source before calls, exact source revision/status/LF hashes before and after every call, no source changes during the experiment.
specification.timing_boundary: One complete library solve, including internal proof reconstruction, training, normalization, lift and physical diagnostics, followed by canonical JSON serialization and SHA256. Excludes gzip/file I/O, external source snapshots and additional saved replay.
